weeks.title: Connect math foundations, Python mechanics and regression
weeks.goal: Be able to manipulate vectors/matrices, differentiate simple losses, trace Python control flow and explain linear regression + gradient descent.

weeks.title: Probability/statistics, algorithmic thinking and classification
weeks.goal: Solve Bayes/expectation/statistics problems, write code using core data structures, analyze basic time complexity and compare regression with classification.

weeks.title: Gradients, neural networks, PCA, clustering and computer vision
weeks.goal: Derive a gradient update, trace a neural-network forward/backward pass, explain PCA and k-means, calculate convolution output dimensions, and recognize basic CV geometry/representation concepts.

weeks.title: Consolidation, timed practice and review
weeks.goal: Demonstrate recall under time pressure, avoid repeat errors, and know when to move on rather than over-study one topic.

tasks.text: Closed-book mini-set: 3 matrix/vector questions, 3 derivative/chain-rule questions, 4 probability/statistics questions. Use MML Chapters 2, 5 and 6 if you need questions.

Attempt [Two Sum #1](https://leetcode.com/problems/two-sum/), [Contains Duplicate #217](https://leetcode.com/problems/contains-duplicate/), and [Valid Anagram #242](https://leetcode.com/problems/valid-anagram/). Time-box each attempt; record whether you needed a hint and state the time/space complexity. Prioritize diagnosing gaps over finishing all three.

Explain without notes: regression vs classification, train/validation/test, loss vs metric, gradient descent, PCA, clustering and neural-network layers. Then solve 5 basic questions from D2L Chapters 3–5.
